name: Curse V
description:
Bursts an enemy for 400% damage and inflicts ABHORRENT CURSE on them. If there's no summon on the field, summon one.

ABHORRENT CURSE: When the unit dies, a Bone Hydra spawns and fights for the summoner's team. It suffers a 10% max HP decay per turn, is three times as likely to be chosen as target, has a 35% counterattack chance and deals 50 physical retaliation damages to melee attackers.
